column1: I, G. S. I. Wimalasena, Divisional Secretary, Mahara of Gampaha
District in the Western Province do hereby give notice, under Section
33 of the Land Acquisition Act that the statutory compensation for
the land acquired for the State and for which no claimant appeared,
as described in the following Schedule is deposited in the District
Court of Gampaha against the case numbers given there in.
